name: BISIK ASMARA
overview: The story follows Noreen (Uqasha Senrose), an independent and successful woman whose life seems perfect but is shrouded in a deepening loneliness. Noreen's life begins to change when Farhan (Zul Ariffin), her colleague who is facing housing problems, needs a temporary rental house. Farhan, on the other hand, is in a long-distance marriage with his wife, Sheila (Sophia Albarakbah) who chooses to stay in the village to take care of her mother, Umi (Ruminah Sidek), who is elderly and suffers from dementia.
